name: s81dv_land_512

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 opt-out (as the coordinator-approved S81 relays / cfifo / Qwen qfd_landh): the RTL registers every data pin -- i is captured flop-first into the 4 ring slots on ck_f (the slots ARE the landing's capture flops, LANDING-CONTRACT L1), o and fault are flops on ck (flop-last, L2/L6); k is a static identity strap tied by the die binder (L7, case-analysed at die STA), rs the regional reset. A flow pin register would add a stage the die calendar (N + 1 + E + 1) does not price and, on i, would capture the lane on one clock before the ring, which is the stage the landing exists to replace.

structural_change: S81-MISC 10-18 (G3, S81-LBGAP bind_table_p4l3 5cb5cddc3): first hardened view of the S81 end-slice lane LANDING dsfd_dvland_512 (ot_s81_land W=512 D=4 KW=3; LANDING-CONTRACT L1-L7), 8 instances in p4l3 (G3: the 52 lanes into the end slices get landing tiles). Same structure, faces, clocks (multiple_cts_roots ck_f lane / ck core, related same frequency) and recipe as the CLOSED sibling dsfd_dvland_562 (s81dv_land_562-l1-1da4d6aae, TT +65.82 / FF +26.06); outline kept 38.88 x 95.04 um (513 data pins per face at 5.4/um; std area ~0.91x of 562 -> util below the 562 view). k[2:0] = identity strap tied by the die binder (case-analysed at die STA). route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.03 (KITS 10-18 rule >= 0.025; the 562 kit used 0.0).

job.purpose: S81 p4l3 end-slice lane landing dsfd_dvland_512 (forwarded-clock ring D 4, read on the block root; 8 inst in bind_table_p4l3, G3)

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_dvland_512 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/ot_s81_land.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/dsfd_dvland.sv && echo lint-ok

benches.name: landing_exact_sweep
benches.pass_regex: LAND_BENCH PASS dsfd_dvland_512 base D=4 KW=3 sweep 36/36 slip-fault 4/4

reroute_reason.fix: route.pin_balance + disjoint per-port pin_ranges: every bus bit placed monotonically (bit k at the same offset on in and out faces, ascending), replacing the closed view's PPL chunk-scrambled order on abutted joints (pin_order rule c81a8f458); RTL, outline, pin faces unchanged; plus kit reset_landing ON (COORD HANDOFF 0jz: 2 ck flops on rs, core release +2 edges re-derived in the die calendar, data latency unchanged)

reset_landing.reason: COORD HANDOFF 0jz (10-19): reset landing ON (ROOT-RST standard, no opt-out). rs lands at its face in 2 plain ck flops (rs__ot_rl0 -> rs__ot_rl1) before the core (wc / rc / warm / fault); the core release moves R0 -> R0 + 2 uniformly and the die calendar (tools/s81_dv/dv_bind.py, bind table landing_reset_stages {master: 2}) opens the hop-0 gate 2 edges later too, so K = E + G - R0 and every data latency are unchanged (land_bench --rst-land 2 base PASS, mut_rlcal = uncompensated calendar FAILS). wc's clear is still asynchronous, now from rs__ot_rl1, released before the lane's first ck_f edge as before.
